review_candidates.title: Central Monitoring Station IT Manager
review_candidates.description: Position Location: This position is located in Irving, TX. Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you? Our Smart Buildings help to create efficient, safe, adaptable, and responsible environments. Our aim isn’t just about improving buildings; it’s about creating perfect places that improve people’s lives. Transform the everyday with us! The Central Monitoring Station IT Manager is responsible for the continuous, uninterrupted operations of the Siemens Customer Service Center (CSC) in Irving, Texas. The CSC consists of a Customer Support Center and a Central Monitoring Station (CMS). The IT Manager will maintain the sophisticated IT architecture that powers this center and processes fire, security and building automation alarms. This will include daily and periodic maintenance, application and equipment upgrades, and rapid response to any casualties that befall the systems. These casualties may occur during the daytime, nighttime or weekend hours. The IT Partner Manager may at times be customer-facing to address IT-related requirements with prospective or existing customers. If you are a seasoned IT professional with significant hands-on experience managing the technological elements of a central monitoring station and are looking to move into an IT Manger role with a global technology leader, this may be your next assignment. As the Central Monitoring Station IT Manager, you will: Maintain continuous (24/7/365) operations of all IT and telephony equipment to allow the center to conduct its various missions, to include building automation monitoring, fire/burglar panel monitoring, video monitoring, access control monitoring, emergency phone monitoring, and various additional customer service tasks. Coordinate with specialty vendors and contract IT engineering consultants to optimize the equipment and application portfolio for effective operations, to include system & application upgrades, warranty service agreements, and new service offerings. Become proficient in the purchase order and invoicing processes. Purchase order origination and invoice reconciliation are both component tasks. You will make an impact with these qualifications: Basic Qualifications: Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office applications 5+ years hands-on experience within an IT infrastructure environment composed of servers, switches, firewalls and work stations. Experience with the elements invoicing and purchasing, to include hardware, software, licensing, warranty purchases, etc. High School diploma or state-recognized GED This is primarily an in-office position although remote work is authorized, when necessary, therefore, residing in close proximity to Irving, Texas is a requirement. Less than 5% travel required with the position. Legally authorized to work in the United States on a continual and permanent basis without company sponsorship. Preferred Qualifications: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or information technology, or significant vocational IT training and five plus years of experience maintaining the IT element of a business, data center or central monitoring station. 5 years of experience as an IT professional in a Central Monitoring Station (CMS) environment, with expert knowledge of signals receivers, concentrators, switches, servers, domain controllers, telephony systems, etc. Experience as the IT Manager at a central monitoring station is a plus. Experience with core CMS alarm integration applications such Security Business Network (SBN) Experience with video monitoring applications such as IMMIX. Experience with access control systems such as SiPass, CCure, Webrix and DSX Experience and competence with SQL Experience working in a pressure-laden matrixed environment, interacting with both customers and internal stakeholders. Experience managing an IT staff of five or more people. Ready to create your own journey? Join us today! About Siemens We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce: We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. #HQ-EREF You’ll Benefit From Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to our employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html The pay range for this position is $92,320 - $158,263 annually. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location.

review_candidates.title: Business Development Manager - Denmark
review_candidates.description: Business Development Manager – Denmark The role of the Business Development Manager is to increase Helvar sales revenue through proactive development of the local market & region. This is a home-office-based role; however, you will be expected to travel regularly to meet customers, predominantly in and around the Copenhagen area. This includes opening new Channels, acquiring new Customers, influencing Building owners, Specifiers, Consultants, and end-users to choose Helvar products and solutions. In parallel the enhancement of existing Partner relationships and supporting our Partner(s) with Helvar project specifications, Marketing activities and training. This is a commercially focused role that blends business development, key account management, new business sales and relationship management, however, a credible level of technical understanding is also required to engage with various parts of the project sales community. You act as a consultant and trusted advisor to your Partners and customers, helping to grow not just Helvar’s business, but their business as well, helping them to generate more business and to bid for and close high value projects. What experiance we like you to have: Experience in managing channel sales programs and sales strategies Procedural driven approach to allow effective streamlining of repetitive sales processes Understanding of the end-to-end sales process from theinitialspecification phase to project delivery Collaborative approach with awareness of the distinct differences in working practices and expectations of different project stakeholders Innovative approach to commercial negotiations relevant to diverse cultural backgrounds and regions of business Good technicalexpertiseand ability to act as application consultant to ensure most effective solution is achieved Able to provide basic product training to Partner’s own sales teams to increase their own sales capabilities Proventrack recordof sales success Ideally some experience from the Lighting, Lighting Control and/or Building Automation industry would be beneficial. What you'll be doing as our Business Development Manager Take full ownership of Helvar business relationships and revenue growth with locally assigned Partners Proactively hunt for and develop new business opportunities together with regional Partners, managing and negotiating project deals Make specifier engagement a key focus, proactively building andmaintaininga strong network of consultants to increase the specification of Helvar solutions across relevant projects. Ensuring significant market activity by Helvar and Helvar Partners including sales, marketing, and events Providetimelyandaccuratemonthly and tertial revenue forecasts Proactively work with Partners to design, develop, and execute growth-focused business and activity plans, agreeing on mutual performanceobjectives, financial targets, and associated critical milestones. Ensure Partners have an in-depth knowledge of Helvar solutions (both sales and technical) to enable them to independently build consistent monthly revenues and guarantee end-user satisfaction. Share Helvar best practices in managing project & specification sales. Coordinate the involvement of required Helvar resources including product management, marketing,logisticsand technical support whererequiredto deliver a best-in-class Partner experience. Demonstrate methodical and precise usage ofHelvar’sCRM system (Salesforce) to constantly build a growing sales pipeline of projects with Partners and to enableaccuratesales forecasting. Deeply understand the local competitor landscape. Analyse and define relevant Helvar advantages and competitor disadvantages to Partners, specifiers, consultants, end users etc. Be the voice of the Partner for new requirements and product development. Become the local figurehead and thought leader for lighting controls, building a visible profile in the local community, sharing best practices in the use of lighting controls to save energy and improve wellbeing Apply to join our team of talented and innovative experts! If you’d like to join the Helvar family, please apply for this vacancy through our Careers site at helvar.com/careers by 17th October 2026. We have included a few questions in the application form that we hope you won’t mind answering. We will be continuously interviewing candidates during the application period and will fill the position as soon as we find the right match! For additional information on the role, please contact our Talent Acquisition & Development Manager: Ben Fryer ben.fryer@helvar.com who will get in touch with you shortly. In the meantime, please give us a follow on Instagram: @lifeathelvar The Helvar Promise to You! At Helvar, we’re determined to improve the wellbeing of people in every space - including our own employees. We promise you conditions that foster your personal growth and help you achieve your full potential. As a tight-knit company with a family ethos, we’re proud to see that Helvarians care deeply about our customers, our partners, our planet and each other. Our drive to create a better working environment is part of what we call Brighter Spaces. We trust your vision! "Over the last 100 years, we've become experts at innovation. It's part of our culture. Together we evolve and adapt our solutions to create perfect conditions.“ We invest in you! "As we spend 1/3 of our life at work, it's important to have fun! We work in a friendly, easy-going atmosphere, and we're focused on improving your wellbeing. We celebrate a learning culture and promote Bright Ideas.” You have the freedom to impact! “People help shape our success. This allows us to be true leaders. With your ideas, we're focused on achieving a brighter, sustainable future for generations to come.” We’re with you all the way! About Helvar Helvar is an international lighting technology company delivering intelligent, energy-efficient lighting solutions for smart, sustainable buildings. By combining advanced lighting controls, environmental sensing, and digital services, Helvar helps create healthier, more productive spaces while reducing energy consumption and supporting long-term sustainability goals. For more than 100 years, Helvar has been at the forefront of lighting innovation, enabling buildings to operate more intelligently through data-driven insights, seamless system integration, and future-ready technology. With offices in Finland, the UK, Poland, and Sweden, and a global partner network spanning more than 80 countries, Helvar provides local expertise backed by international reach. With over 300,000 projects delivered worldwide across a wide range of industries and applications, Helvar offers wired, wireless, and hybrid lighting control solutions, environmental sensing technologies, and a cloud-based digital services platform. Together, these solutions form a comprehensive end-to-end ecosystem that helps customers optimise building performance, enhance occupant wellbeing, and achieve their sustainability ambitions. Helvar Recruitment Equality and Diversity Disclaimer At Helvar, we are committed to creating a workplace that promotes a culture of equality, respect, and opportunity for all. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, or any other characteristic protected by law. We value the unique perspectives and experiences that each individual brings to our team and encourage everyone to apply. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to get in touch.
